csharp_space_around_binary_operators #

Spacing around binary operators. Observed and not implemented: at none the oracle closes up assignment, additive, multiplicative, relational, shift, bitwise and logical operators at once. It is a generalized key whose expansion set the registry does not record, and whose domain (before_and_after/none/ignore) is not the bool domain of the keys it would name, so honouring it needs a value mapping as well as an expands list.

Typestring
Defaultbefore_and_after
Default known fromnothing beyond the export
